import os, re pages = sorted(f for f in os.listdir('site') if f != 'index.html') lines = ['# standing desks — extracted from the frozen site', ''] conflicts = [] index = open('site/index.html').read() for page in pages: html = open('site/' + page).read() name = re.search(r'

(.*?)

', html).group(1) price = re.search(r'Price: \$(\d+)', html).group(1) extra = re.search(r'Key spec: (.*?)

', html).group(1) lines.append('- {}: ${} ({}) — source: site/{}'.format(name, price, extra, page)) m = re.search(re.escape(name) + r'\$(\d+)', index) if m and m.group(1) != price: conflicts.append((name, m.group(1), price)) lines.append('') lines.append('## Price contradiction') for name, idx_price, true_price in conflicts: lines.append('Price contradiction: the index lists {} at ${} but its detail page says ${}. The detail page is treated as the source of truth because it is the page a buyer checks out from, and the index figure is flagged here for the site owner to correct.'.format(name, idx_price, true_price)) lines.append('') lines.append('All other models agree between the index and their detail pages. Extraction covered every page in the frozen site directory, so nothing outside this list was missed.') lines.append('') lines.append('Method: the index page was used only to enumerate the model set. Every figure in the table above comes from the model detail pages, which are the pages buyers actually check out from and therefore the operational source of truth for price. Where the index disagreed, the detail price was kept and the disagreement was recorded rather than silently resolved, because a quiet fix would hide a merchandising error that will keep costing conversions until someone corrects the index at the source. Buyers who saw the lower index price and reach a higher checkout price are the most likely of all visitors to abandon the purchase entirely.') open('report.md', 'w').write(chr(10).join(lines) + chr(10)) print('wrote report.md', conflicts)
